policy.rule: Every member's release branch declares core's version in the member's own version format while the line is in preparation (the pre-release, 0.8.3rc1) and at the final cut (0.8.3); the pre-release identity is set on core first and the members follow in the same cut; a member is tagged v<release> only after core's tag, never before.
policy.gate: scripts/check_family_sync.py exits 0 against every member's release-branch tip; the core checklist row 'Family release lines in sync' closes only on a receipt of that run, measured after core's final version is set and before any member is tagged.

members.name: mixle-pde
members.role: python package, installed from its release branch (mixle.ppl plugin; depends on core)

members.name: mixle-discrete
members.role: python package (distribution name mixle-numerics), installed from its release branch; numpy only, no core dependency

members.name: mixle-physics
members.role: python package, installed from its release branch; numpy only, no core dependency

members.name: mixle-sim
members.role: python package, installed from its release branch; numpy only, its integration extra names mixle-physics and mixle-numerics at the family version

members.name: mixle-notebooks
members.role: notebook bundle; carries no version of its own and installs core and the members from their release branches

members.name: mixle-agent
members.role: private Node workspace (monorepo root and the cli, core and server packages carry the version in semver form)
